name: cinemetric
description: Claude skills for your Plex server. Read-only reports on your media and server, plus mods for Claude Code: a read-only guard, a library status line and a Now Playing panel.

read_only_guard.title: Read-only guard
read_only_guard.description: Stops Claude from running its own commands that would change your Plex server, Tautulli or plex.tv, and keeps your Plex token and Tautulli API key out of what Claude sees and sends. Meant to be switched off only by you.

library_status_line.title: Library status line
library_status_line.description: Shows your Plex library's size and when Cinemetric last checked it, just above the prompt. Read from snapshots on this computer; never contacts your server.

now_playing_pane.title: Now Playing
now_playing_pane.description: Lets /cinemetric-now open a panel showing who's streaming from your Plex server right now. It checks the server about every 30 seconds, only while the panel is open.
